command: kubectl get deployment tiles -n geo-99fa -o yaml

kubectl apply -f tiles.yaml -n geo-99fa --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl set env -f - ENV_TEMP=true -n geo-99fa --dry-run=client -o yaml 2>/dev/null || kubectl apply -f tiles.yaml -n geo-99fa --field-manager=tiles-update
kubectl get deployment tiles -n geo-99fa && echo "---" && kubectl get pods -n geo-99fa -l app=tiles
kubectl get deployment tiles -n geo-99fa -o yaml | grep -A 4 "selector:" && echo "---" && kubectl get pods -n geo-99fa -l app=tiles,scheme=v2 --no-headers
